evidence_limit: Only the C proposal and its manifest were read. Repository facts are proposal-cited or previously reviewed contract invariants, not a fresh inspection/rebase of dd00c61. No source implementation or runtime proof claimed.

recommended_smallest_slice.name: S05a bounded candidate + compile-only evidence + inert diff
flow: One explicit source/edit roster and one immutable Host-known compile policy
Same Coordinator/Task/Run/epoch and existing DB; fresh disjoint Host-owned baseline/candidate directories
One bounded native candidate turn; original dirty bytes preserved
After complete native stop/drain, seal exact candidate bytes; fixed offline compile-only check, never execute generated binary
One authoritative result REPORT references baseline/candidate/diff/check LOG or MANIFEST seals
Show sealed diff and precise compile result; no apply/commit/push/automatic repair or second model turn
recommended_smallest_slice.supported_case: One tiny public Go fixture with fixed go.mod/check metadata and bounded editable source roster; no arbitrary repository clone or arbitrary project tests
recommended_smallest_slice.why_useful: Produces an actual implementation and reviewable same-byte diff without silently turning model-authored code into a generally trusted test program.

five_required_adjustments.requirement: Freeze a side-by-side candidate API/closed DTO lane; do not extend the closed rev2 artifact or its literal-false capabilities in place.
concrete_minimum: Recommended namespace /harness/candidate/v1: capabilities, POST tasks, GET tasks/list/request_id lookup, GET task, GET events, POST cancel
Distinct wire api_version and candidate request/task/event/capability schemas; current /harness/v1 rev2 byte-shape/readonly behavior unchanged
Old list/get/events cannot receive candidate records or fail projection because candidate private input differs; filter before old projection
Freeze mode/operation-specific idempotency lookup and key conflict semantics so ACK recovery never returns or dispatches a task from the other lane
Clients that only implement rev2 remain readonly and see no candidate tasks/fields; new thin clients are a later explicitly scoped bridge/validator addition
five_required_adjustments.scope_impact: The proposed13 production files omit new candidate wire schemas/route allowlist/client response validation resources. Add exact contract/schema/route paths when Root registers lease; do not hide new fields in old harness_v1 validators.

five_required_adjustments.requirement: A trusted test policy does not make model-edited package code safe to execute. Go test executes package init/TestMain even with -run=^$; offline module flags and Windows Job cleanup do not confine filesystem/network effects.
concrete_minimum: First policy: fixed compile-only invocation such as pinned go test -c with explicit output, CGO disabled, local toolchain, offline modules and isolated caches. Do not execute the generated program; label COMPILE_PASS/COMPILE_FAIL, never TEST_PASS
If functional tests are required first, admit only a reviewed side-effect-free candidate language subset, or independently qualify a real execution boundary for the candidate code before running it
Check_policy_ref resolves to immutable executable/argv/env/input-closure hashes on Host, never caller/model executable arguments
Permissions qualification must cover both native candidate writing and check processes; a Job contributes stop/drain/ownership facts only

five_required_adjustments.requirement: Define baseline as the exact current authorized on-disk dirty bytes, not HEAD/index or model transcript. Make its digest deterministic and preserve originals.
concrete_minimum: Freeze explicit counts/total/per-file bounds and canonical Windows spelling, case collision, link/reparse/special-file rules; fixed policy metadata is outside edit roster
Seal sorted path/type/size/content-hash inventory and exact baseline bytes before dispatch; new/missing/deleted/empty files are distinct states
Original root is a read source only; candidate and sealed baseline are disjoint, no .git/config/credential cloning or original index mutation
After actual native stop/drain, freeze candidate inventory, derive diff from those exact baseline/candidate bytes, run checks against those exact frozen inputs, then rehash
Original later changes affect applicability only, not historical candidate/diff truth; no continuous-workspace-correctness claim and no S09 apply

five_required_adjustments.requirement: Keep one authoritative Run/result membership and defer candidate terminal projection until the complete pipeline settles. Native completion alone must not call the old readonly finish path early.
concrete_minimum: Continue the original lease/revocation/cancel guard through prepare/native/check/seal, not only native Wait
Persist check-attempt intent and actual before-Resume identity under original Run/epoch with a stable check key; do not overwrite the native model process identity

Use existing DB/ArtifactUse/immutable artifacts for facts, but freeze exact artifact kinds/use roles: one authoritative REPORT, auxiliary Host manifests/logs/diff referenced by exact sealed refs/hash/size
If any phase lacks positive durable completion facts, Recover+Scan becomes UNKNOWN/fenced and never relaunches native or checks; first slice needs no automatic phase resume
Final projection and terminal event remain one Tx; check nonzero, NOT_RUN, upload failure and unknown cleanup never become success
No new scheduler/parallel task DB; if existing storage cannot enforce a durable check launch claim, resolve that concrete storage contract before promising at-most-once checks

five_required_adjustments.requirement: Write READY_FOR_REVIEW as an executable predicate, not a label for process exit or captured files.
predicate: Current authorized project/workspace and supported bounded policy
Exact baseline/candidate/fixed/check/toolchain/profile hash binding matches sealed Run evidence
Every declared required check actually completed successfully under its declared kind, with stop/drain/cleanup proved
Candidate and fixed bytes still match checked inventory; all required artifacts sealed and visible
Actual required candidate-write/check permissions qualification is valid for the pinned producer/profile/toolchain context
not_ready: UNVERIFIED permissions/trusted-check boundary: explicit BLOCKED/UNQUALIFIED reason, not READY
Missing or uncertain facts/cleanup: UNKNOWN, no restart dispatch
Known nonzero check: CHECK_FAILED with retained candidate/diff/raw evidence
Compile-only success may be reviewable only as explicitly compile-only; no test/business acceptance claim
Old completed Runs are not retroactively qualified when later resource evidence arrives

minimum_lease_order: Root freezes new candidate wire lane + policy/readiness/artifact-role contracts and exact supported limits

One backend vertical on current integrated Main: intent/admission -> typed Host snapshot/candidate -> one native turn -> compile-only check -> seals/diff -> projection. Same Coordinator; ordinary readonly branch unchanged
Separate thin-client lease consumes new lane and existing authorized artifact content, inert escaped diff only
Only then a separately registered real permission allow/deny fixture and actual bounded model/check observation; no generic READY before evidence
few_critical_regressions: Old rev2 strict clients parse old responses unchanged and never see candidate tasks
Dirty original/file/index inventory stays unchanged; diff hashes equal sealed baseline/final bytes
Wrong policy/roster/path/owner/context or changed fixed/check input fails closed before launch/READY
Check failure, NOT_RUN, byte mutation, cancel/revocation and upload/terminal-event fault retain evidence and never cause a second native/check launch
Public capability/readiness remains unqualified until actual permission evidence, even when all fake Job fixtures pass
out_of_scope_now: Arbitrary test execution or generic Windows sandbox guarantees
